title: [Synthetic] Is NativeAOT mandatory for a Windows .NET title?
body: Invented docs/feature question at source SHA 8ae3563d2fcd9ecffd45ec15c436bacf3ee44033: I see net8.0, net10.0 and netstandard2.0 in the projection. Must I enable PublishAot to use it in an ordinary Windows title, and is netstandard2.0 itself an AOT publish target? Is the CI ILC compilation sufficient evidence that user sign-in works in a packaged sandbox? Please point to the existing project settings and documentation before proposing new APIs.
